topic: Releasing analytics fix for traffic dashboard
summary_markdown:
A data issue was identified on the traffic dashboard where data disappears when setting a working time. The proposed fix was reviewed, and initial testing confirmed it works correctly.

**Decision:** The team decided to release the fix on Tuesday (the following week).

The client (via Fishman) had initially requested the feature/fix, but they agreed to wait for the scheduled release date.
decisions: The analytics fix for the traffic dashboard will be released on Tuesday.
